\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}

% TikZ style definition — stripped by build_minimal_preamble
\tikzset{
  curarrow/.style={
    rounded corners=8pt,
    to path={-- ([xshift=-50pt]\tikztostart.center)
    |- (#1) -- (\tikztotarget)}
  }
}

\begin{document}
% Usage of the tikzset-defined style in a tikzcd diagram.
% Without the \tikzset above, pdflatex fails:
%   ! Package pgfkeys Error: I do not know the key '/tikz/curarrow'
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node (A) at (0,0) {A};
  \node (B) at (2,0) {B};
  \draw[curarrow] (A) -- (B);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
